nvitk.gui.viz.centerline
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.viz.centerline

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Napari helpers: skeleton junction detect / cut on centerline masks.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: JUNCTION_POINTS_LAYER
   :value: 'Skeleton junctions'


.. py:data:: JUNCTION_META_KEY
   :value: 'nvitk_junction_source'


.. py:function:: _require_centerline_volume(layer: Any) -> numpy.ndarray

   Return *layer*'s data as a host 3D array with at least one foreground voxel; raises
   ``ValueError`` if the layer isn't 3D or is entirely empty.


.. py:function:: detect_junctions_from_layer(layer: Any, *, label_id: int | None, min_degree=3, reskeletonize=False) -> numpy.ndarray

   Junction voxel coordinates from a 3D centerline mask.


.. py:function:: add_junction_points_layer(viewer: Any, junctions: numpy.ndarray, *, reference_layer: Any, source_layer_name='', min_degree=3) -> Any

   Add or replace skeleton junction markers.


.. py:function:: read_junction_coords(viewer: Any) -> numpy.ndarray

   Read junction voxel coordinates from the Skeleton junctions Points layer.


.. py:function:: cluster_junction_coords(junctions: numpy.ndarray, *, cluster_radius_vox=1) -> numpy.ndarray

   Collapse nearby junction markers to one representative voxel per cluster.


.. py:function:: _nearest_polyline_indices(polyline: numpy.ndarray, junctions: numpy.ndarray, *, min_separation_points=2) -> list[int]

   Map each junction cluster to one cut index on an ordered centerline polyline.


.. py:function:: split_label_at_junctions(label_volume: numpy.ndarray, source_label_id: int, centerline_polyline: numpy.ndarray, junction_coords: numpy.ndarray, *, new_label_start=None) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, list[int]]

   Split *source_label_id* into new labels at junctions along *centerline_polyline*.

   Junction voxels are removed from the source label; each branch between cuts is
   rasterized with a new label id (qvtpy-style branch split).


.. py:function:: centerline_polyline_for_label(centerline_layer: Any, label_id: int, *, reskeletonize=False) -> numpy.ndarray

   Longest-path polyline through one label on a centerline mask (for junction cuts).


.. py:data:: POLYLINE_SHAPES_META
   :value: 'nvitk_centerline_polylines'


.. py:data:: DEFAULT_POLYLINE_LAYER
   :value: 'Centerline polylines'


.. py:function:: centerline_mask_to_polylines(centerline: numpy.ndarray, *, labels: list[int] | None = None, min_branch_points: int | None = None, reskeletonize: bool = False, smooth: bool = True, smooth_window: int = 5) -> list[dict[str, Any]]

   Convert a labeled centerline mask into connected branch polylines.

   Uses :func:`~nvitk.morphology.centerline.compute_connected_centerline_tree`
   so each label keeps its main path plus every unique junction-split branch
   (shared only at bifurcation voxels — no dropped corridors).

   :param min_branch_points: Drop edges shorter than this many voxels. ``None`` / ``<= 0`` keeps
                             every edge with at least 2 points.


.. py:function:: add_centerline_polylines_shapes(viewer: Any, polylines: list[dict[str, Any]], *, reference_layer: Any, layer_name: str = DEFAULT_POLYLINE_LAYER, edge_width: float = 0.35) -> Any | None

   Add Napari Shapes paths for centerline polylines (replace prior layer).
